WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand,
           COUNT(DISTINCT f.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM fielding AS f
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id
    GROUP BY p.bats
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count,
           AVG(player_count) AS average_count
    FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT h.batting_hand,
       h.player_count,
       1.0 * h.player_count / t.total_count AS share_of_total,
       h.player_count - t.average_count AS above_average
FROM hand_counts AS h
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE h.player_count > t.average_count

assumptions.assumption: A missing batting hand is grouped as SQL NULL, separately from blank strings; NULL values form one group. Shares use the sum of the per-hand distinct-player counts as the total.
